## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

HomeViewModel — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/home/HomeViewModel.kt

## Trigger

The link between the phone and the watch being established (no such
event exists in the codebase today; would need a connectivity-state
source to call into HomeViewModel).

## Today

HomeViewModel.onSyncClicked is the only caller of
RecordedRaceSyncService.sync, fired solely by the "Synchroniser" tap
on the watch's home screen. HomeViewModel's init block only launches
ConnectivityPermissionManager.onLaunch(), observeReference(),
profileRepository.observe() and recordedRaceSyncService.observe() —
nothing observes the phone-watch connection becoming established (no
such event or listener exists anywhere in core-domain, core-data,
app-phone or app-wear). RecordedRaceSyncService.sync stops at the
first race whose send or save fails and sets its state flow to
Failure; nothing schedules or attempts a retry at a later connection —
the state only leaves Failure on the next manual "Synchroniser" tap.

## Expected

Establishing the link between the phone and the watch also calls
RecordedRaceSyncService.sync, with no button tap needed. A pull that
stopped on a send or save failure at that point is retried
automatically the next time the link is established, rather than
staying failed until the user taps "Synchroniser" again.
